why: Eyeful v2 = pinhole (22 cams); indoor office room; 71 rig positions / 1562 images (2K JPEG 2 GB); shown as a pinhole example in HybridNeRF Fig. 7 (Office 1B, Office View 2, Riverview, Apartment).

protocol.split: splits.json; v2 rule = all images of camera 17 held out. office1b: 1491 train / 71 test.
protocol.resolution: 2K (HybridNeRF: 'HDR images at 2K resolution'). Raw 2K JPEG = 1368x2048 distorted; COLMAP export images_4 = undistorted PINHOLE ~1477x2250 (per-camera 1471-1486 x 2232-2260).
protocol.colour: NeRF methods trained on HDR in PQ space, evaluated after tonemap to sRGB; 3DGS is a non-HDR baseline (sRGB). JPEGs = HDR x per-scene WB (office1b 0.725535,1,1.839938) + sRGB curve. No per-image exposure/colour correction stated -> compare plain PSNR, not PSNR_cc.
protocol.unstated: exact pinhole scene list, how 3DGS handled radial-tangential distortion (COLMAP export did not exist until Oct 2024), 3DGS iterations/settings, metric code.

published.source: HybridNeRF (Turki et al., CVPR 2024) Table 1 'Eyeful Tower results', Pinhole columns = MEAN over pinhole scenes; identical in Turki thesis CMU-CS-24-132 Table 4.1
published.per_scene: NOT PUBLISHED: no per-scene Eyeful table in HybridNeRF arXiv HTML, CVPR PDF, or the thesis; VR-NeRF Table 2 is iNGP ablations at 1K over all scenes, no 3DGS.

verified: pycolmap 3.10 loads it: 22 PINHOLE cams, 1562 images, 1,290,323 points; 0 size mismatches; test all cam 17, no overlap; reprojection median 0.13 px, p90 0.39 px; COLMAP frame == cameras.json frame (metric, y-up), similarity scale 1.0, residual 1.6e-7 m
